url = "/level-revalidate-cross/:step?" title = "Level Revalidate Cross" layout = "default" is_hidden = 0 [wizard] == wizard->define(function (WizardBuilder $builder) { $builder ->step('step-1', 'Step 1') ->fields([ ['name' => 'field1', 'label' => 'Field 1'], ]) ->rules(['field1' => 'required']) ->extraValidation(function ($validator, $data) { return ['derived' => $data['field1'] . '-derived']; }) ->end() // Its extra validation reads the data of step-1 (a cross-step // closure): on revalidation it must see the same accumulated // context it had in its original validation. ->step('step-2', 'Step 2') ->fields([ ['name' => 'field2', 'label' => 'Field 2'], ]) ->rules(['field2' => 'required']) ->extraValidation(function ($validator, $data) { if (empty($data['field1'] ?? null)) { $validator->errors()->add('field2', 'The earlier step data is missing'); return; } return ['stamp' => $data['field1'] . '-stamped']; }) ->end() ->step('step-3', 'Step 3') ->fields([ ['name' => 'field3', 'label' => 'Field 3'], ]) ->rules(['field3' => 'required']) ->revalidate() ->end(); }); } ?> == {% component 'wizard' %}
